CamThink Launches NeoEyes NE503 Open Edge AI Camera Platform | News

turns.answer:
**Pre-installed Models**

The NE503 ships with three pre-installed AI models: **Person Detection (YOLOv8n)**, **Face Landmarks**, and **CLIP Image Encoder**. [1][2]

These models support rapid development and evaluation of camera-side AI workloads. Custom Hailo HEF models can additionally be imported through the Web Console or registered with aipc-cli. [1]
